title: One Crestline Credit Card Account per Person
content:
**Rule.** A person may hold only one Crestline Credit Card account — the limit is 1 account per person. A new application cannot be submitted while the applicant has another Crestline Credit Card account in status applied, active or suspended.

## What blocks a new application

| Applicant's existing Crestline Credit Card account | New application |
|---|---|
| applied (decision pending) | cannot be submitted |
| active | cannot be submitted |
| suspended | cannot be submitted |
| declined | does not block; the bank decides the new application on its own merits |
| closed | does not block; the bank decides the new application on its own merits |

The test is read from the system's card account records for the applicant, not from the applicant's own account of what they hold.

## Related points

- **Authorized users** are added by the bank and are not separate accounts.
- Because the cap is one account, nothing is aggregated across card accounts.

## Cases on hypothetical records

- An applicant whose only earlier account shows status closed may submit a new application.
- An applicant whose earlier application still shows status applied may not submit a second one until that application is decided; if it is then declined, the declined account no longer blocks.
